name: sarif-atlas
description: SARIF files from code scanners and linters: summary, results by file, top rules. Pro: new results against a baseline and a suppression audit. Works offline.

commands.title: SARIF Atlas: Show Results By File
SARIF Atlas: Remove Licence From This Machine

walkthroughs.title: Get started with SARIF Atlas
walkthroughs.description: Open a sample SARIF file, see its summary, results by file and top rules, and try the Pro new-results report and suppression audit in the free 14-day trial.

steps.title: Open a sample file
steps.description:
SARIF Atlas reads SARIF files: the JSON results format that code scanners, security tools and linters write. The sample is an invented scan of a web shop by two tools, with baseline states and suppressions, so every report has something to show. Open it to follow along, or open a SARIF file of your own.
[Open Sample File](command:sarifAtlas.openSample)

steps.title: Run Show Summary
steps.description:
The log at a glance: results per level, the tools and versions that produced them, suppressed results and how many rules fired. The report opens as a new Markdown document; your file is not changed.
[Show Summary](command:sarifAtlas.showSummary)

steps.title: Use the other free reports
steps.description:
Every free report works without a key, an account or a network connection: Show Results By File, Show Top Rules.
[Show Results By File](command:sarifAtlas.showResultsByFile)
[Show Top Rules](command:sarifAtlas.showTopRules)

steps.title: Try Pro free for 14 days
steps.description:
The first Pro command you run starts a free 14-day trial on this computer, with no key and no network: Show New Results, Show Suppression Audit.
[Show New Results](command:sarifAtlas.showNewResults)

steps.title: Licence and help
steps.description:
Buy Pro (Personal USD 19, Business USD 39 per user), enter a key, see the licence status, or report a problem.
[Show Licence Status](command:sarifAtlas.licenceStatus)
[Report A Problem](command:sarifAtlas.reportProblem)

sarifAtlas.maxFileSizeMB.markdownDescription: Largest file (in MB) a report reads, up to 50 MB (VS Code passes files only up to 50 MB to extensions). Larger files are refused with a message.

sarifAtlas.openReportsAsPreview.markdownDescription: Open each report in the Markdown preview as well as in a new editor.
